name: Melisa
source: While Kira seems to be the most calm and collected, Melisa seems to be the most depressed from the new life. Just before she went to college, just before she had so many opportunities in life in front of her, it all ended with one push of a button. Sometimes it is hard for you to recognize her she was always so optimistic, the sunshine of the company, but now, she prefers to spend time in her room alone. You usually can see her at the dining table and at the movie nights that Oscar still makes.
